event_chain.summary: Use of stolen creds on email accounts

summary: On May 20, 2026, employees of the Connecticut Department of Children and Families received phishing emails that led to the compromise of at least two DCF email accounts. Investigators believe the attacker downloaded emails from the accounts, which may contain personal information and confidential records. The Department of Administrative Services removed the attacker from state systems and disabled the compromised accounts; DCF is reviewing the emails to notify affected individuals and offer credit monitoring.
